user.title: Connect to a CamStack hub
user.description: Link this Home Assistant to your CamStack hub. Linking sends you to the hub's own login page and Home Assistant never stores your password.

oauth.title: Connect to a CamStack hub
oauth.description: Enter the address of your hub. You will be sent to the hub to sign in and approve the link, then returned here. The sidebar panel and the Lovelace card use this same address.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the hub.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off if the hub uses a self-signed certificate.

manual.title: Connect with a username and password
manual.description: Enter the address of your CamStack hub and an account it will accept. The sidebar panel and the Lovelace card use this same address.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the hub.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off if the hub uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with CamStack
reauth_confirm.description: Enter an account the hub will accept. Until it has one, this entry serves the sidebar panel but creates no entities.

data_description.host: Confirm the hub address. It was derived from the URL your panel was already using and may point at a reverse proxy rather than at the hub itself.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this off if the hub uses a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub at that address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected those credentials. Accounts protected by two-factor authentication cannot be used here.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.oauth_unsupported: This hub did not answer the linking endpoint. Update the hub, check anything sitting in front of it, or continue with a username and password.

abort.oauth_error: The hub did not return a valid link. Try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: The hub did not answer in time.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: The hub refused the link request.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not obtain a token from the hub.
abort.missing_configuration: The CamStack integration is not configured for linking.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the link to the hub.
abort.no_url_available: No link could be generated. Check that Home Assistant knows its own external address.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The link was not approved on the hub.

init.title: CamStack panel
init.description: The sidebar panel and the Lovelace card follow the hub address you configured. Override it only if your browser reaches the hub at a different address than Home Assistant does.

data_description.panel_icon: Any Material Design Icons name, for example mdi:cctv.
data_description.panel_url: Leave empty to use the configured hub address.
